newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy July industrial turnover up 4.4 pct yr-yr.
newsitem.headline: Italy July industrial turnover up 4.4 pct yr-yr.

text.p: Italian industrial turnover rose 4.4 percent year-on-year in July while orders fell 0.8 percent, national statistics institute Istat said.
Year on year change +4.4 pct -7.5 pct +18.7 pct
Year on year change -0.8 pct -15.4 pct +22.0 pct
Note: Istat said the increase in turnover was especially marked in the electrical machinery sector where sales climbed 22.7 percent.
In orders, there was a 32.3 percent increase in demand in the transport sector and a 12.0 percent climb in orders placed in the leather industry.
Over the first 7 months of 1996, industrial turnover rose 1.2 percent with orders falling 3.9 percent. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
